title: AAPS Stops Delivering Bolus and Basal at Random Times — Requires App Restart
symptom: At random times, AAPS stops delivering both bolus and basal insulin. The progress line at the bottom flickers rapidly, and the user sometimes wakes up with very high glucose due to no insulin overnight. Restarting the app via Exit option temporarily resolves the issue.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. A maintainer states that the connection is not established by Android and there is nothing to do on AAPS side, but no specific cause is identified.
fix: No definitive fix is provided. Temporary workarounds include selecting Exit from the AAPS menu to restart the app, and toggling Bluetooth off and on for a few seconds.
evidence_quote: The connection is not established by Android. There is nothing I can do on AAPS side
